text:
This is for all the people that are unaware about KAI & his music being nominated for multiple awards & additional details:
Please vote for KAI's "Mmmh" on M Wave's website: https://www.mwave.me/en/vote/mcountdown/vote . Voting ends on December 14th.
It's for M COUNTDOWN PRE VOTING. It seems like another music show.  You could sign-in with a social account: KAKAO, Twitter, NAVER, LINE, Facebook, Tumblr, Google, weibo.com, & We Chat. 1 vote per account, though. You could use as many accounts you want to vote for KAI. 

If you are a fan of EXO and/or KAI, please help support this brother by voting for him wherever he's nominated. 
You could also download the apps, CHOEAEDOL, IDOL CHAMP, FanPlus, MuBeat, Whosfan, V Live, etc. from the Google Play Store & Apple Store. 
Here's at least 3 websites from KAI's trusted fanbases: stationkai.com , erigomnation.com & kaivoting.page . 
KAI's solo fandom's name is Erigom (L bear), but he often refers to his fans as EXO-L or Eris & other variations of the name. 
EXO's fandom name is EXO-L (EXO-Love). 
Of course, if you can, please continue to stream all of KAI's solo music videos & other solo related videos, including his solo performance videos, because views are included in the voting criteria. 
You don't have to do anything you don't want to do, but it would greatly appreciated if you could join us in helping to support the new solo artist, KAI aka Kim Jong-in. It would be a wonderful early birthday gift. His birthday is on January 14th.  

Kim Jong-in aka KAI deserves for us to at least try to vote & help him win some awards for working very hard to give us his solo project & all this extra content that we didn't know we wanted, but we are glad we received it. It's just a way to show your gratitude. 
I'm sure he'll appreciate us making an effort, although he is very humble & didn't ask us for anything in return. 
However, like any other artist, he just wants people check out & appreciate him, his art & his other work. 
As you can see, this brother is very passionate about his craft. I haven't noticed him do anything halfway. Also, he's a perfectionist, who is sometimes too hard on himself, although everyone else thought he did an amazing job. 
He's even not afraid to express his emotions in a society with some people who often give some males a hard time for being in tuned with their emotions & sensitive side. He's not afraid to breakdown gender barriers either. He's a very artistic, quirky, intelligent, hilarious, kind-hearted & down to earth, respectable, personable, & multitalented guy. 
This is the same guy that was surprised that he had more international fans than he thought did & that a lot people enjoyed his dancing, his work, & him in general. 
Just watch some of his latest videos & feel him out for yourself. You'll see the type of person he is for yourself. He's a stand up guy. 
KAI is just a stage name & a charismatic idol persona, Kim Jong-in is the complex man behind the "KAI" image, & Nini is the very soft & shy side of Kim Jong-in. His duality is something special. 

Also, he's doing a lot of self-promoting activities almost like an independent artist & some things he wanted to do for himself, his family & loved ones, & his fans. This solo project is KAI aka Kim Jong-in's baby. SM finally gave him more creative freedom to what he wanted to do. 
Therefore, it's KAI's vision, not SM's doing. What you see & get is coming from KAI & his team. Don't give SM too much credit when they don't deserve it. Moreover, KAI invested his blood, sweat & tears into his solo project, especial his own money.

Anyway, if you are interested & use Twitter, Facebook & Instagram, please search for more info. Even Google, if it's necessary. 
It's OK to watch his introduction guides to learn more about KAI aka Kim Jong-in, but please make sure you pick good up to date ones. 
Follow KAI's Instagram account: zkdlin @ instagram.com/zkdlin . 
Again, here's at least 3 websites from KAI's trusted fanbases: stationkai.com , erigomnation.com & kaivoting.page .  
A lot information is available on these websites. They have more, but I don't know them all, sorry. These are the main ones I know. 
Reminder: KAI's solo fandom's name is Erigom (L bear), but he often refers to his fans as EXO-L or Eris & other variations of the name. 
EXO's fandom name is EXO-L (EXO-Love). 
Here's a website that offers some basic info about Kim Jong-in aka KAI & is often used by some new fans: https://kprofiles.com/kai-profile-facts-kai-ideal-type/ . 
Last but not least, please feel free to ask his most knowledgeable fans, some Erigoms & EXO-Ls since they are the ones who support KAI the most. Keyword: Some, not all.

text: I came to a realization that Kai really is indeed a professional artist. I'm suddenly reminded of when SM confirmed his solo debut back in June, then SuperM came back with a new album but it didn't feel like he chose one over the other. I respect him so much for that, we could all assume that there's already a lot of pressure on him to debut as a soloist but not once did he complained about SuperM nor talked bad about SM delaying his solo and told us to wait patiently for it and support SuperM along the way. This film is beyond what I imagined and expected, all those months of waiting makes sense now, everything is exquisite. You really just had to trust in the process. I am once again proud.

author: @litanchik7933
text:
Я понимаю, что Кай у нас танцор хороший, но кто ему ставил танец в первой песне? Вы же видите, что у него резкие движения без каких-либо переходов. Поэтому танец странно смотрится. Душа есть, а грации тела нет. Такие танцы не для него. Либо может было слишком мало времени на проработку. Я не вижу общей задумки танца, к сожалению. Может, Кай, тебе стоит просто не так сильно напрягаться во время танца? Попробовать следовать за телом, а не контролировать его полностью... В общем, честно не знаю... :(
Остальное все прям огонь!) Постановки, эффекты в клипах тоже очень классные!)) Решили видимо выжать по максимуму)) 
Кай, я знаю ты очень добрый. И, возможно, ты чувствительнее, чем Бэкхён. Поэтому не обижайся, пожалуйста, у меня нет цели обидеть тебя. Ни в коем случае. :) Я просто приношу в этот мир немного критики в том, что вижу :) Воспринимай это как зоны роста, а не минусы ;)
И удачи тебе с релизом нового альбома! :)

text: Bunga sakura sangat unik. Bunga ini akan cepat mekar namun juga cepat gugur. Bunga sakura hanya akan bertahan seminggu. Ketika sudah melewati waktunya, semua bunga di pohon sakura akan habis berguguran di tanah dan menutupi sekelilingnya dengan warna merah muda yang indah.

author: @user-gj8qh9iy3c
text:
Arti, Filosofi, & Makna dari Bunga Sakura

Atau secara filosofis dilambangkan sebagai siklus kehidupan. Filosofisnya yang dikatakan sebagai sebuah siklus kehidupan memiliki makna dimana ada kebahagiaan akan diakhiri dengan kesedihan, di mana ada kelahiran akan diakhiri dengan kematian.

author: @user-gj8qh9iy3c
text: Bunga sakura adalah bunga dari banyak pohon dari genus Prunus. Spesies yang paling terkenal adalah ceri Jepang Prunus serrulata yang biasa disebut sakura.

text: Anyelir, atau disebut juga bunga teluki dan dikenal dalam bahasa Inggris sebagai carnation, mempunyai nama ilmiah Dianthus caryophyllus adalah tanaman hias pekarangan dan pot yang populer. Tanaman ini berasal dari kawasan Mediterania.

Apa perbedaan antara sayur dan sayuran?
"Sayur", sebagai kata dasar untuk sayuran, merupakan komponen pendamping nasi (atau makanan pokok lainnya) yang berkuah cair atau agak kental. "Sayuran" adalah segala sesuatu yang berasal dari tumbuhan (termasuk jamur) yang dapat disayur; dengan pengungkapan lain: segala sesuatu yang dapat atau layak disayur.

author: @logant2838
text:
Mr. Kim Jongin aka KAI.

I'll be back. I won't always leave a comment. Just know, I'm still watching & playing this masterpiece while I'm relaxing & chilling or working. I had to add this video to a playlist, so I could listen to your music as I go about my day. 
I'm still in awe over your artistic vision, YOUR VOCALS, & your music choice.

Honestly, your vocals & concept is what blew me away the most. I knew you were an amazing dancer; you are one the best in Kpop; you are one of my favorite performers; you dance like your life depends on it; you express yourself very well through your music & artistry; from your head to your toes, you use your whole body to tell a story; you are also a perfectionist. Jongin, you are living, breathing ART. 

Moreover, I knew you could sing, but I didn't know you could SANG like this, sir. 
You are an ace, SM's hidden gem, & I'm sure Kyungsoo aka D.O. is very proud since he loves your vocals. 
Recently, Baekhyun said you have a sexy voice, music & your body motivates him. I'm just paraphrasing what he said. 

Whenever I listened to an EXO & a SuperM song, I often focused on your beautiful unique vocals. 
However, I just feel like your voice isn't utilized well enough in your band's songs. That's why I tend to watch KAI vocal compilation videos, because your vocals are so underrated. 
Your smooth, sweet, honey, emotional, & sexy vocals. Your vibrato, though. :-) Your changes in vocal tones & pitch. 
Come through, KAI. 
You, Kyungsoo, Baekhyun, & Chanyeol are my favorite vocalists in EXO. 

KAI, I already know your upcoming performances will be exceptional; you will leave it all on the floor. I'm very excited to hear the full songs & watch your other solo content. 
This all feels surreal. We finally got a KAI solo album. I've been wishing & praying for this for years. Unbelievable. If I'm dreaming, please don't wake me up. I want to bask the glory of your special solo moment as long as I can. :-D

author: @bibliothecalexa
text: @@megonfearon9257 ​ I don't remember in which songs, live performances or group precisely but imo kai has definitly showcased his vocal progress and "new found" range before. Not in one go, but slowly throughout the years, bits by bits,  but unless they focused on his parts not many people seemed to take notice of his hard work to become a better vocalist. Personnally, I can hear him in all of these songs because his voice has always been one of my favorites so I naturally paid more attention to him. To say there is no autotune would be a lie bc every artists puts autotune on their studio vers.(even live vers.) it's a question of arrangement and details not talent, but if you're actually asking if it is really him reaching those notes or a machine helping him: yes it's him no doubt. Kai worked hard to get where he is now, it was time people put a respect on his name when they talk about Exo vocalists.

author: @sugusko
text: S ve J'nin kadim dostluğu çok eskiye dayanır. Bir gün uzak dünyada eski zamanlarda birbirine rakip iki köy varmış. Bir köyde S ve ailesi, diğer köyde J ve dostları varmış. Bir gün iki köy arasındaki gerginlik giderek artmış. Öyle ki bu iki köy arasında ev, bahçe yakmalara kadar uzamış. İlk köyden yani S nin yaşadığı köyden bir kişi J'nin yaşadığı köye gelmiş. Bu duruma bir son vermeye çalışmış. Fakat J'nin yaşadığı köydeki halk S'den gelen kişiyi idam etmiş. Bunun üzerine J'nin yaşadığı köy savaşa hazırlanmış. İki tarafta birbirlerinin köyüne ajanlar yollamış. Savaş günü gelip çattığında ise S ailesinin adına savaşa gitmeye karar vermiş. J ise dostlarıyla çarpışmaya karar vermiş. İlk saldırıyı S'nin yaşadığı köy yapmış. J'nin dostlarından bir tanesi ise bu saldırıda ölmüş. J ve arkadaşları onun için bir cenaze bile hazırlayamamışken saldırıya geçmeye başlamış. Savaş 1 hafta sürmüş. İki köy de fazlasıyla zararda çıkmış. Kazanılanlar ve kaybedilenlerin arasında açık bir ara olduğu bu savaşın son damlaları gelmiş. J bir arkadaşı ile kalmış. S ise ailesini korumak adına hala hayattaymış. İki tarafta dinlenirken J arkadaşıyla konuşmaya başlamış. Arkadaşı " Bu savaşı saldırarak veya savunarak kazanamayız. İki tarafın da anlaşması gerekiyor." demiş. S ise ailesiyle konuşmuş ve J'nin arkadaşının önerisinde bulunmuşlar. Ertesi gün savaşın bitmesi gereken gündü. Bir taraf galip olacaktı. Fakat J öne çıkarak iki köy arasındaki savaşta yüksek seslerle bağırmaya çalışmış. "Savaşı bitirelim dostluk kuralım!" fakat kimse onu duymak istememiş. S ise J'nin çığlıklarına karşılık vererek ona katılmış. Savaşta iki köy de farklı köylerden iki kişinin beraber olduğunu görünce savaşı durdurmuş. Onların seslerine kulak vermişler. İki köy de verilen kayıplardan muzdarip olup savaşı bitirme kararı almış. J dostları anısına S'nin olduğu köye bir anıt yaptırmış. Bu anıt bu savaşın unutulmaması için zaman boyunca orada kalmış. İşte böylelikle S ve J'nin kadim dostluğu başlamış.

text:
TURKİSH EXO-L

S ve J'nin kadim dostluğu çok eskiye dayanır. Bir gün uzak dünyada eski zamanlarda birbirine rakip iki köy varmış. Bir köyde S ve ailesi, diğer köyde J ve dostları varmış. Bir gün iki köy arasındaki gerginlik giderek artmış. Öyle ki bu iki köy arasında ev, bahçe yakmalara kadar uzamış. İlk köyden yani S nin yaşadığı köyden bir kişi J'nin yaşadığı köye gelmiş. Bu duruma bir son vermeye çalışmış. Fakat J'nin yaşadığı köydeki halk S'den gelen kişiyi idam etmiş. Bunun üzerine J'nin yaşadığı köy savaşa hazırlanmış. İki tarafta birbirlerinin köyüne ajanlar yollamış. Savaş günü gelip çattığında ise S ailesinin adına savaşa gitmeye karar vermiş. J ise dostlarıyla çarpışmaya karar vermiş. İlk saldırıyı S'nin yaşadığı köy yapmış. J'nin dostlarından bir tanesi ise bu saldırıda ölmüş. J ve arkadaşları onun için bir cenaze bile hazırlayamamışken saldırıya geçmeye başlamış. Savaş 1 hafta sürmüş. İki köy de fazlasıyla zararda çıkmış. Kazanılanlar ve kaybedilenlerin arasında açık bir ara olduğu bu savaşın son damlaları gelmiş. J bir arkadaşı ile kalmış. S ise ailesini korumak adına hala hayattaymış. İki tarafta dinlenirken J arkadaşıyla konuşmaya başlamış. Arkadaşı " Bu savaşı saldırarak veya savunarak kazanamayız. İki tarafın da anlaşması gerekiyor." demiş. S ise ailesiyle konuşmuş ve J'nin arkadaşının önerisinde bulunmuşlar. Ertesi gün savaşın bitmesi gereken gündü. Bir taraf galip olacaktı. Fakat J öne çıkarak iki köy arasındaki savaşta yüksek seslerle bağırmaya çalışmış. "Savaşı bitirelim dostluk kuralım!" fakat kimse onu duymak istememiş. S ise J'nin çığlıklarına karşılık vererek ona katılmış. Savaşta iki köy de farklı köylerden iki kişinin beraber olduğunu görünce savaşı durdurmuş. Onların seslerine kulak vermişler. İki köy de verilen kayıplardan muzdarip olup savaşı bitirme kararı almış. J dostları anısına S'nin olduğu köye bir anıt yaptırmış. Bu anıt bu savaşın unutulmaması için zaman boyunca orada kalmış. İşte böylelikle S ve J'nin kadim dostluğu başlamış.

4 Malzemeli Pişmeyen Tatlı Tarifi İçin Malzemeler

Krem şanti yerine artmış kremanızı çırparak veya muhallebi kullanabilirsiniz. Dilediğiniz bisüvileri kullanabilirsiniz. Dilerseniz içerisine fındık, ceviz vb. gibi yemişler de ekleyebilirsiniz. Çilek reçeliniz yoksa farklı reçeller kullanabilir, dilerseniz çeşitli marmelatlar da tercih edebilirsiniz. Varsa artmış çikolatalarınızı da kuplara ekleyebilirsiniz. text:
) A group of 119 Israelis, including 30 professors, 25 rabbis, and around 20 medical doctors and scholars, recently signed an open letter to the new Israeli Health Minister, Yuli Edelstein.

Among the signatories are former Deputy Speaker of the Knesset Mr. Moshe Feiglin; former Knesset member Mr. Yehudah Glick; Prof. Jacob Lavee, who has been leading efforts to stop the Chinese Communist Party’s killing of Falun Dafa practitioners for organs in China; and chief rabbis of several cities and communities in Israel.

The letter calls on the Minister of Health to examine and immediately stop all cooperation between Israel and China in the field of organ transplantation. This includes preventing Chinese physicians from training and attending professional conferences in Israel, as well as stopping all cooperation in research and development between the two countries in the face of the Chinese regime's forced organ harvesting of prisoners of conscience.

The signatories believe that a law should be enacted immediately to impose criminal liability on all forms of cooperation with Chinese entities on organ transplantation, including by private Israeli companies.

In addition, the signatories asked the Minister of Health to stop direct and indirect transmission of Israeli citizens’ genetic information to Chinese state-owned companies. Furthermore, the signatories call for immediate action to end Israel’s dependence on Chinese medical equipment and to re-examine the need for, and moral justification of, existing “twin hospital” agreements between Israeli and Chinese hospitals.

Two Israeli media outlets covered the issue: a radio station interviewed one of the signatories, and an online Russian TV station interviewed the petition’s initiator.

The petition was submitted to the Ministry of Health at the end of May, but no reply has been received so far. 

The project was started by an Israeli Falun Dafa practitioner, who suggests that practitioners in other countries consider taking similar initiatives.

author: @ZYaruru
text:
@alia ehsan Neither do you. As far as I know, you're the one who came to my comment to downgrade it, so please, take this opportunity to go a bit further.

(Keep in mind I stated "if all the music industry" to which you replied "hollywood music industry is full of", there's a subtle difference that exist between your statement and mine, I let you find it.)

author: @ZYaruru
text:
@alia ehsan Then you mistook my comment for "no one has ever achieved that", which is *not* what I said. I'm talking about a standard, a standard which is not achieved, for various reasons. Kai conveys more than just a nice visual here or nice music, there's more to it like messages, hints, references, which does not necessarily applies to what everyone else does (everyone=/=no one=/=some). Having good visuals doesn't make your work profound of meaningful and that's I'm talking about here; there's a difference between a simple singer, performer, and an artist putting their soul and all in what they do, which is what he did here. Now is it new? No. Has Hollywood invented it? Nope, neither. Does the fact that it exists elsewhere makes it less impressive? No. I have listened to bunch of artist going beyond Kpop or Hollywood, in fact I'm quite a worldwide listener, but rarely do artist manage to embrace their own universe in what they do because the majority is performing what OTHERS dictate and decide for them, in order to follow the trend etc. Is it bad? Not necessarily. But it's not what I am looking for on a personal level.
What I've been basically saying was: the standard should be giving free creativity to artists and giving them the means to express themselves. Which is not as common as you might think it is. Another example of who I consider to be a true artist with super high standard would be Aurora. Does that explain it a bit better for you now? (PS: Hollywood is not a standard omg I sincerely hope you don't believe the world revolves around the USA because that's extremely self-centered)

author: @palestblue
text:
Updated theories - here is my interpretations so far:

Hello Stranger: Kai is lost, not sure who he is and unable to connect with his real self (cloth around the face his alter ego/shadow self). He's possibly only seeing himself as someone who was created for entertainment purposes (projected self, also fits with the title being his stage name 'KAI').

Reason: Is about the question why he performs - is it for the money? To live a life full of gold and (too much) food, too much of everything? (Dinner scene and fancy, golden room that reminds me of french royalty and their affluence). Does he do it to perform for others, for senseless entertainment? (Dancing in a pretty cage, people don't even see his face/don't see him as a person, just their dinner entertainment).

Amnesia: Here, he is trying to run away from it all, from his career, his life, his fame, his success (train tracks). Also possibly imagery of someone running away from the circus (red trains, sparkly suit) and the cruel job of being an entertainer. This part might also be alluding to another ways of running away from life/ending everything (light as if of an oncoming train).

Mmmh: This could be about him traveling and seeing a lot of new things, worlds opening up and up and up, about seeing that there is more to life and the world than he knew before. And it ends in a wide open space and a beautiful sky that might symbolize new (inner) freedom.

Nothing on me: Here, he seems to take the time to really breathe and look at who he is, what he wants to be and what he wants to stand for. About wanting to dance for the pure joy and art of it (artistic performance, mirrors, dancing passionately in white, then red). Also possibly the idea of struggling with and finally embracing different parts of one's soul? (Female figure in the mirror). Or she could symbolize the trap of trying to find one's identity solely through a relationship that he briefly falls into but frees himself of, finally finding his true identity within himself and who he is and wants to be independent of the opinion of others.

Ride or Die: Having connected with his true core and values, he has new determination and strength. He performs in the middle of a crazy big stage with lots of light and focus on him, but not solely to entertain, to gain fame or wealth. He dances because he loves to and loves this form of artistic expression. And so the stage is no longer frightening as it seemed at the beginning of the film, but a place to be who he is and who he wants to be.

What do you think? What are your theories?

author: @palestblue
text:
My current theories:
Hello Stranger: Kai lost, not sure who he is and unable to connect with the real him (cloth around his alter ego/shadow self). Possibly only seeing himself as a projection/someone who was created for entertainment (projected self)

Reason: The question why he performs - is it for the money to live a life full of gold and food and too much of everything? (Dinner) Does he do it to perform for others for senseless entertainment? Is this success?! (Dancing in a pretty cage)

Amnesia: Trying to run away from it all (train tracks) also possibly the idea of running away from the circus (red trains, sparkly suit) and the cruel job of being an entertainer. Also possibly alluding to other ways of running away from it all (light as if of an uncoming train)

Mmmh: Traveling and seeing a lot of things, worlds opening up and up and up, seeing that there is more to life and the world

Nothing on me: Taking the time to really breathe and look at who he is, what he wants to be and stand for. Wanting to dance for the pure joy and art of it (artistic performance, mirrors, dancing passionately in white, then red). Also possibly the idea of struggling with and finally embracing different parts of one's soul? (Female figure in the mirror). Or she could symbolize the dangers of trying to find one's identity solely through a relationship?

Ride or Die: Having connected with his true core and values, he has new determination and strength. He performs in the middle of a crazy big stage with lots of light and focus on him, but not solely to entertain, to gain fame or wealth. He dances because he loves to and loves this form of artistic expression. And so the stage is no longer frightening as it seemed at the beginning of the film, but a place to be who he is and who he wants to be.

What do you think? What are your theories?

İhtiyacımız olan malzemeler: çaydanlık, su, siyah çay ve şeker.

Список постсоветских мультфильмов с 2000-го года: Александра Петрова ("Старик и море" и т. д.), «День рождения Алисы», "Алёша Попович и Тугарин Змей", "Добрыня Никитич и Змей Горыныч" "Карлик нос", "Новаторы", "Смешарики", "Князь Владимир", "Крепость. Альманах "Гора самоцветов": "Колобок", "Шейдулла-Лентяй", "Пётр и Петруша", "Гордый мыш", "Егорий Храбрый", "Солдат и Смерть", "По колено ноги в золоте, по локоть руки в серебре", "Ну, вот ещё!" и т. д.

Также есть мультфильм от студии "ШАР", где работают советские мультипликаторы и их ученики: "Две принцессы", "Нос майора". 
Киностудия Башкортостан им. А. Абдразакова выпустила мультфильмы Рима Шарафутдинова: «Ни пуха ни пера», «Алдар и серый волк», «Волшебная история», «Охотник Юлдыбай», «Сын охотника», «Глупый волк». 
А на YouTube'е можно найти такие интересные студии, как: 
"АнимАрс" («Хоттабыч – свобода!», «Песня Хапугиных», «Секретные Приключения Арса», «Пять этажей над уровнем ада», "Антидепрессанты", "О, повелитель!", "Отжигаем"). 
ReminorBand ("Курьер"). Это по-настоящему взрослый и интересный мультсериал. Можно сказать, что это продолжатель советской мультипликации.
Авторы из Arzamas'а выпустили "Короткие мультфильмы о букве, слове и языке". 
Также не могу не упомянуть мультсериал Metal family. Его создают почти практически два человека на своём YouTube-канале. 
Их 9 и 10 серии просто шедевр. 
Ну и новые "Смешарики" вышли. 
В этом году должен выйти полнометражный мультфильм "Огонёк-огниво", который подаёт большие надежды. 
Ещё началось создание полнометражного мультфильма по комиксу "Еркетай" от Khan Comics, что тоже даёт большие надежды. 
Отдельного упоминания заслуживают «Осторожно, Земляне», «Колобанга», School 13, «Бременские музыканты» 2000-го года, Level Up.....

author: @Nini-be5ve
text:
Jongin is about to start a new era in kpop. Correct me if i am wrong but i don't remember seeing another group/soloist doing a visual album until him. 
He included movie and pop culture references, mixed fashion and dance (2 things he is known for). This whole film is an art. Jongin wants to show his artistry. It's gonna be a cultural reset because it was never done before. 
Not to mention the quality of the songs, his vocals (!!) did you hear the runs and the adlibs in mmmh and amnesia? Don't forget Jongin prepared this since march, he personally chose the songs. He participated in everything for this solo. 
That's what you call a genius. He is a genius. The impact this solo is gonna have i am affraid but thrilled at the same time to see how things will go from now.
By the way, i saw some comments regarding the budget you have to understand this : Jongin decided to give us this. He is the one who chose to invest this much money after all these years. Sm didn't provide all this money. They are just gonna take what they need on the earnings of the album. So enjoy what he gave us. Because he decided to gift us this whole masterpiece. He said quality over quantity
